Explanation:  
The Predicted Answer identifies William Mansfield, 1st Baron Sandhurst as the Commander-in-Chief from 1865–1870, states that he died at age 57, and that his wife (named as Margaret Fellowes/Lady Sandhurst) died at age 64. It then calculates the average of their ages at death as 60.5 and correctly rounds up to 61. The Ground Truth Answer provides all the same substantive information: both individuals’ names, their ages at death (57 and 64), and the averaged, rounded result (61). The minor difference in the wife’s name (Margaret Fellowes vs. Margaret Mansfield, Baroness Sandhurst) does not diminish the substance, as both refer to the same individual, and all crucial facts are present.
